user.title: Select Yunmai scale
user.description: Wake the scale before opening this form. If no device is listed, enter its Bluetooth MAC address.

profile.title: Recognition profile {number} of up to {maximum}
profile.description: The integration recognizes the nearest profile from the live weight, then sends it to the scale before the final measurement. Age is estimated automatically from the birth year.

data.sex: Sex used by the scale algorithm

error.invalid_birth_year: Enter a birth year corresponding to an age from 10 to 120

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported Yunmai scale

recognition.title: Recognition thresholds
recognition.description: Conservative settings reduce incorrect assignments. The relative difference is a fraction: 0.10 means ±10%.

data.max_stable_spread_kg: Maximum spread in the frame window (kg)

bluetooth_power.title: Bluetooth power optimization
bluetooth_power.description: Experimental local-BlueZ setting scoped only to this scale address. The maximum-tested preset is recommended for this scale. Choosing Custom opens a second form. Changes reload this integration and are applied after every local connection; Bluetooth proxy connections are unchanged.

bluetooth_power_custom.title: Custom Bluetooth power parameters
bluetooth_power_custom.description: Advanced experimental settings. The base interval must be a multiple of 1.25 ms. The supervision timeout must be greater than 2 × interval × (latency + 1). Invalid combinations are rejected before saving.

data_description.ble_power_interval_ms: The shortest interval used when the scale has data to send.
data_description.ble_power_latency: How many consecutive connection events the scale may skip while idle.
data_description.ble_power_supervision_timeout_s: How long the controller tolerates missed events before disconnecting.

profiles.title: User profiles
profiles.description: {count} of {maximum} profiles are configured. Adding, editing, or deleting a profile preserves every other profile.

profiles_add.title: Add profile {number} of up to {maximum}
profiles_add.description: This adds one profile without changing existing profiles. Age is estimated automatically from the birth year.

data.sex: Sex used by the scale algorithm

profiles_edit_select.title: Select profile to edit
profiles_edit_select.description: The profile UID is preserved so existing entities and stored measurements remain associated with the same user.

profiles_edit.title: Edit {name}
profiles_edit.description: Only this profile will be changed. Its stable Yunmai user ID is preserved.

data.sex: Sex used by the scale algorithm

profiles_delete_select.title: Select profile to delete
profiles_delete_select.description: At least one profile must remain configured.

profiles_delete_confirm.title: Delete {name}?
profiles_delete_confirm.description: Delete profile {name}, currently referenced at {weight} kg? This does not delete other profiles.

error.invalid_birth_year: Enter a birth year corresponding to an age from 10 to 120
error.invalid_ble_interval: Enter 7.5–4000 ms in exact 1.25 ms increments
error.invalid_ble_latency: Enter a peripheral latency from 0 to 499
error.invalid_ble_timeout: Enter a supervision timeout from 0.1 to 32 seconds
error.ble_timeout_too_short: The supervision timeout must be greater than 2 × interval × (latency + 1)

abort.user_cancelled: Setup was cancelled. No changes were saved.
